 Parimal Halder & Ors.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Tapas Kumar Mondal
 Mr. Partha Sarathi Basu

This revisional application has been filed by the present petitioner for quashing of the charge sheet being no.647 of 2024 under Section 498A/323/354B/406/34 of Indian Penal Code dated 30th June, 2024 in connection with Chakdah Police Station Case No.533 of 2024 dated 13.05.2024 pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kalyani,Nadia.
2.

entities.text: Chakdah Police Station Case No.533 of 2024
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is specifically contended by the learned advocate representing the petitioner that the same de facto complainant, who is the wife of the present petitioner no.1, lodged a complaint in the month of June 2023 against other in-laws alleging torture upon her and no such allegation of torture was levelled against the husband.

Interestingly, after about one year another complaint was lodged by the said de facto complainant where it has been alleged that since after one year from the date of marriage which was commenced 14 years ago her husband along with other in-laws are inflicting torture upon her.
Prima facie, there are contradictory statements made by the de facto complainant against the present petitioner no.1/husband.

Furthermore, other petitioners are residing separately which is stated by him in paragraph 5 of his petition and they have no relation between the petitioner no.1 and petitioner nos.2,3 and 4.
3.
Perused the record and the contents of the complaints lodged by the de facto complainant on both dates which manifest contradictory statement made therein against the petitioner no.1 is concerned.
In both cases charge sheets have been submitted.
However, in view of such discrepancy in the statement it is necessary to hear the matter after giving an opportunity of hearing to the opposite parties.

Hence, the petitioners are directed to serve a copy of the revisional application alongwith all annexures upon the opposite parties by speed post with acknowledgement card due and to file affidavit-of- service on the next date of hearing.

The petitioners are granted Parimal Halder & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190439576/
1 liberty to pray for stay of the pending proceeding if any such situation arises in course of pendency of the matter.
4. List the matter in the Combined Monthly List of November 2025 before the Regular Bench.
5. Parties are directed to act on a server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of the Hon'ble High Court at Calcutta.
